objective: Port netty-testsuite-http2 4.2.19.Final (io.netty.testsuite.http2: the Hello World HTTP/2 server that h2spec runs against) to Netty.NET.Testsuite.Http2 with the original names, structure and comments, and an explicit evidence-backed record for each CLR adaptation and each unit that is not ported.

ownerDecisions: Project, folder and assembly names are the namespace root of the module (owner decision 2026-11-19, see docs/codec-base-porting.md): each module takes the namespace of its main package, and the tests use <project>.Tests like the other test projects.

2026-11-26: the project is Netty.NET.Testsuite.Http2, the namespace root of io.netty.testsuite.http2 (the 2026-11-19 rule; no new name choice), and its CLR supplemental smoke tests are Netty.NET.Testsuite.Http2.Tests. The project is an executable under test/, because the Maven module is a runnable h2spec target that is not deployed (skipDeploy in pom.xml).

statusMeaning.verified: Every declared original test is mapped to a C# test with the same name (case may differ) and passes.
statusMeaning.clr-adapted: Ported with the original names, structure and comments; every CLR difference is stated in a // CLR: comment and in this entry.
statusMeaning.jvm-only-replaced: JVM-only metadata or documentation unit replaced by its recorded CLR counterpart.

supplementalTests.scope: CLR supplemental: the module declares no JUnit test (its build runs h2spec). The cases bind Http2ServerInitializer on a loopback port and take each path once: HTTP/1.1 without an upgrade attempt (keep-alive and Connection: close), the h2c upgrade answered on stream 1, and HTTP/2 with prior knowledge (a GET and a request body echoed by onDataRead). They are not a conformance run.

review.scope: SimpleChannelInboundHandler<IFullHttpRequest>; FullHttpRequest/FullHttpResponse are IFullHttpRequest/IFullHttpResponse and ctx.alloc() is ctx.Alloc(), as in codec-http. ctx.write(msg) is WriteAsync with the Task discarded, as Java discards the ChannelFuture. ChannelFutureListener.CLOSE on the write future is a Task continuation that closes the channel on its event loop through Common's EventExecutorTaskScheduler, as codec-http's CorsHandler maps it. cause.printStackTrace() writes the exception to Console.Error, as codec-http2's LastInboundHandler. The package-private constructor is internal.

Sealed Http2ConnectionHandler subclass that implements IHttp2FrameListener with public members; Http2Headers, Http2ConnectionDecoder and Http2ConnectionEncoder take the I prefix. request.headers().get(HOST) returns a String that Java keeps as a CharSequence, and request.uri() is passed as one; both are wrapped in Common's StringCharSequence (docs/codec-http-porting.md, Shared CLR adaptations). encoder().writeHeaders/writeData are WriteHeadersAsync/WriteDataAsync with the Tasks discarded, and ctx.newPromise() is a new TaskCompletionSource, as codec-http2's internal Http2CodecUtil.NewPromise(). cause.printStackTrace() writes to Console.Error. RESPONSE_BYTES and the constructor are package-private in Java and internal here.

Sealed AbstractHttp2ConnectionHandlerBuilder<HelloWorldHttp2Handler, HelloWorldHttp2HandlerBuilder>. The public build() widens the protected base method; a C# override cannot change the accessibility of the virtual method, so it is a public member declared new that calls base, as codec-http2's Http2ConnectionHandlerBuilder. INFO is handler's LogLevel.INFO and HelloWorldHttp2Handler.class is typeof(HelloWorldHttp2Handler). The package-private constructor is internal.

run() and main(String[]) block on bind(port).sync() and closeFuture().sync(); they are RunAsync() and the async Main, which await the Task of ServerBootstrap.BindAsync and the channel's CloseFuture. group.shutdownGracefully() is ShutdownGracefullyAsync() with the Task discarded, as Java discards the future. NioServerSocketChannel.class is Channel<NioServerSocketChannel>(). Integer.parseInt is int.Parse with an optional sign and the invariant culture, as codec-http's HttpResponseDecoder. The project is an executable (OutputType Exe) whose entry point is this Main. The package-private constructor and run() are internal.

ChannelInitializer<ISocketChannel>. The public initChannel(SocketChannel) widens the protected ChannelInitializer.initChannel; a C# override cannot change the accessibility of the virtual method, so it stays protected. UpgradeCodecFactory/UpgradeCodec are HttpServerUpgradeHandler.IUpgradeCodecFactory/IUpgradeCodec and HttpMessage is IHttpMessage. The anonymous UpgradeCodecFactory is the nested CleartextUpgradeCodecFactory and the anonymous SimpleChannelInboundHandler<HttpMessage> the nested NoUpgradeAttemptedHandler, which takes maxHttpContentLength from the initializer. System.err.println/System.out.println are Console.Error.WriteLine/Console.WriteLine. The package-private constructors are internal.

h2spec.didNotEnd: In 4.3/2 and 6.10/6 the server answers a connection error with GOAWAY and closes while h2spec still sends, which resets the connection. h2spec 2.2.0 on Windows then reads the reset connection in a loop (wsarecv 'forcibly closed' logged 561,968 times in 5 seconds with -v); it ends a check only on EOF, ECONNRESET or a timeout. h2spec 2.6.0 ends a check on any read error and treats WSAECONNRESET and WSAECONNABORTED as a closed connection.
